programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
香港早晨粵 及 亞太眼科學會特約:香港眼科 · 全球視野粵
手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 阿塞拜疆拉伊奇的銅工藝經過加熱、敲打等工序，全憑有經驗的工匠的感覺製成。這工藝不止是藝術, 亦是他們的主要生計，更會出現在婚禮、餐桌上，與他們生活的各方面息息相關。

programme.title: 世界獨特社區粵普
programme.desc: 丹麥自由城是獨立運作的社區。擁有自己的法律、旗幟和獨特的生活方式。孕育了一個自由、民主和博愛精神世界。印度黎明之城 3300名來自世界各地的居民, 放棄了私有財產，貢獻自己的能力，為整個社區提供服務。

programme.title: 芬蘭潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 回到芬蘭首都赫爾辛基，必玩焗桑拿、跳海體驗。帽子品牌以環保為理念，將無用的布料升級再造，深受當地人支持！品嚐熊肉、馴鹿肉料理之後，芷珮到服飾家品品牌特賣場掃平貨。由芬蘭乘船往愛沙尼亞只需兩小時，郵輪上設有商店、自助餐區，不知不覺便抵達目的地。塔林古城區被列為世界文化遺產，芷珮逛小店、喝啤酒配熱湯；及後換上十五世紀服裝參觀歷史悠久的藥房，祕探古老藥方。電視塔上開設了環迴景觀餐廳，讓人歎着佳餚賞美景！

programme.title: 玩轉香港日與夜粵
programme.desc: 九龍西舊建築羣經活化後換上不同身份，延續使命，推動社區發展。昔日荔枝角醫院經歷逾百年風霜，變成推廣中華文化的園地。郭子豪、陳庭欣走進昔日工廠大廈，發揮藝術天份，試製玻璃器具。石硤尾初代公屋見證香港社會發展，莊思明、莊思敏入住其中，體驗獅子山堅毅精神。登後山俯瞰深水埗，萬家燈火熱鬧景象活現眼前；汝州街遍佈手作材料商店，成為女生週末最愛「蒲點」。鐵皮棚仔市集外表陳舊，竟是時裝設計師的尋寶聖地？

programme.title: 週六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 年輕人潮流觸角敏銳，愛好探索新事物、新資訊。踏入科技年代，青少年對新興電子產品、網絡流行媒體尤感興趣，追上時代步伐，已成新世代指標！主持開設《週六聊Teen谷》，會用盡所能搜羅世界各地至潮、至新情報，上至世界盛事、醫學百科、文藝與科技；下至日常生活、網絡熱搜，在每個星期六跟觀眾一一分享。論盡天南地北，暢談人氣熱話，「谷友」緊貼節目，便可輕鬆掌握全球脈搏動向。

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」瞭解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 煮東煮西粵
programme.desc: 雞蛋是百搭食材，煮東煮西滋味滿分！保哥以肉碎、韭菜碎等餡料煎蛋餃，打造豐富口感層次。在熱鍋上翻起蛋皮不簡單，嚳儀、自瑤輪流挑戰，結果大不同！家嘉炮製「粟米水波蛋煙肉杯」，前來監場的黃浩然為愛妻遞水放閃。煮水波蛋要加鹽加醋，也有科學原理？蒸水蛋平平無奇，保哥用菠菜、紅蘿蔔巧製三色水蛋，翠如卻自揭蒸水蛋未曾成功？家嘉以牛角酥當酥皮，變奏焗蛋料理，親子下廚之選。嚳儀靚湯時間，帶來「苦瓜鹹菜黃豆排骨湯」。

programme.title: 煮東煮西粵
programme.desc: 當牛肉遇上木瓜，平價肉質部位都可炒出高檔口感？保哥以鑊氣炒公仔麵帶出隱藏的科學小知識。見識過保哥的拋鑊功架，翠如、自瑤也會露兩手……小朋友不愛喫飯麵？家嘉有「煮意」，將香濃紅酒牛柳配上脆多士，連大朋友都要清碟！煮醉牛腱的花雕白滷水汁是美味關鍵，蠱惑翠如卻教詩雅如何現成醉汁扮自家製？家嘉烹煮「日式咖喱牛肉酥」，獲三位閨密協助製作酥皮，滋味昇華！嚳儀帶來消暑冬瓜老鴨湯，並藉「魚露滴管」增添做實驗童趣。

programme.title: 全城一叮粵PG
programme.desc: 港人渴望外遊，黃建東藉着鬼馬的音樂唱作，帶大家遊勻全世界「識女仔」，還差點走過地府一趟？對手林子超在鋼管上「飛舞」，爆肌大跳高難度動作，全場血脈沸騰。他還衝破心理關口，坦蕩蕩面對胸口上的疤痕！第四輪對壘上演男女舞伴PK戰，黃瀅仴、吳兆麟透過舞蹈展示情侶從爭執到和好，還融入抬舉招式、小提琴元素。黃紫恩、劉展霆則變身小丑與小丑女，舞出極度瘋狂的愛情故事，玩得夠曳！雙方勢均力敵，勝負只差一分……

programme.title: 聲級學堂粵
programme.desc: 二十強學員投入第二階段配音訓練，認識日常生活的聲效技巧，喫麵、喝水，以至漱口、刷牙，原來都有竅門，導師們作正確示範，並點出學員常犯小錯誤。為配音打好基礎，必先戒除懶音陋習，翟耀輝老師傳授改善懶音速成班，齊來正視懶音！深入講解外語劇的配音難度，注意配合日、韓語的聲調與節奏，如何改善學員的「甩嘴」情況？發揮想像力，體驗旁白、廣告配音，有學員未能發揮水準，更淚灑當場……還會認識練習「數口」對配音的幫助。

programme.title: 地球大神祕粵
programme.desc: 今年是人類充滿惶恐不安的一年，網絡上流傳不少大災難的預言：中東戰火、日本超級大地震等，我們的明天究竟會怎樣呢？很多人想預知未來，研究它的真假，在網絡資訊爆炸的時代，越講越真，越知道反而越驚，就好像聖經一早預言：『人想起將要臨到世界的事，就嚇得魂不附體』這一刻，站在文明懸崖上的我們，是否正要見證這古老預言成為現實？在全新一輯的地球大神祕，我們會繼續從世界各地神祕事件，探討各種預言的真確，還會同被稱為最準確重要的預言書《聖經》作對比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 後空翻少年粵日
programme.desc: 蒼秀館與白鳴高的共同集訓終於迎來最終日，但距離歸去時間還剩一段時間，大家繼而在真白提議下，進行一場兵捉賊的遊戲。由於扮演兵的兩個粗枝大葉的隊長，大家都在藏匿途中疏於防範，甚至為不同看法大吵一頓……

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 多鍛練身體協調性，參與不同運動時亦會有較好的表現，一於跟隨兒童體適能教練「WORKOUT 2GETHER」。雙腳夾緊瑜伽磚後「開合跳」，同時以左右手傳遞另一塊瑜伽磚；轉為躺下的姿勢，把瑜伽磚放於雙膝之間，升起下盤，再於頭部上方、臀部下方不停用手傳磚，極之講求協調性。接着要利用普拉提球來訓練背部肌肉，透過身體不同部位的力量，控制好普拉提球的移動與身體的平衡，同時訓練肩關節的靈活度，有助改善寒背狀況。

programme.title: 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神祕怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧祕。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神祕怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧祕。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子打電話找野口，誰知接電話的是富士男，變成小丸子要替富士男想白色情人節該送什麼禮物。小丸子家裡屋頂被風吹壞，前來的維修師傅叫宮園，帶著結他和狗的他意想不到的親切風趣，更會唱歌。

programme.title: 這十年幸福中國粵
programme.desc: 本片從城市到鄉村，以科技、社會、民生、體育、文化等多個角度出發，用小故事展現大主題、用小視角透視大時代，記錄各行各業普通人的工作與生活，體現幸福是奮鬥出來的思想。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠臺每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 新聞透視粵 及 亞太眼科學會特約:香港眼科 · 全球視野粵
programme.desc: 公營醫療服務收費架構2003年確立後，今年迎來最大幅度調整，除了急症室、住院服務、專科門診和家庭醫學門診加價外，非緊急放射診斷和標準藥物等亦要收費。公立醫院一直照顧全港九成病人，不少中產亦因為公私營醫療服務收費差異大，而到公立醫院就醫。醫管局期望透過加價改變市民求醫習慣，減少浪費和濫用，是否有效呢？長遠要如何減輕公共醫療負荷？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 青衣有單位睡房玻璃現裂痕，管理公司拖延多月仍未動工；測量師拆解玻璃「自爆」原因。旺角街頭借錢黨再現，事主被騙現金外，附近生果店亦同樣有損失，事情來籠去脈如何？有駕駛者倒車時碰撞了後車一下，向後車提出賠償，對方卻報警，更錄口供指事主拒賠，事後更發函追討61萬損失！汽車保險顧問細說車輛碰撞後的處理方法。《聲秀》甄敏芳來自澳門，帶外景主持遊覽她熟悉的地方。郭富城到馬場出席活動，透露女兒想收到馬匹做禮物？

programme.title: 圓玄學院呈獻：慈善星輝仁濟夜粵
programme.desc: 鍾鎮濤率先登場，真摰獻唱<愛過的夢與<當你靠著我，呼籲觀眾踴躍捐助。張與辰接力演繹<當年情，周吉佩、冼靖峯、李金凱各自獻聲，還聯同蕭凱恩、安德尊等帶來感動人心的音樂劇。胡鴻鈞以<恆溫行李傳遞暖意，Hey Brother則<型男而上。馬德鐘更率《非常檢控觀》演員現身撐場。林奕匡<那些不愛我的人、陳展鵬<巨輪，相繼亮相。壓軸由「阿姐」汪明荃以歌聲匯聚善心，誠邀各界攜手為仁濟醫院注入力量。

programme.title: 尋歡作樂的姐姐粵
programme.desc: 藉跑步記錄城市風情，沛珈隨帥哥地膽晨跑，沿途還有不少打卡點。日式傳統料理以西餐方式重新演繹，玲玲姐帶沛珈前往人氣廚師發辦餐廳，品嚐喉黑魚、黑金鮑等極尚滋味。古鎮轉型文旅新天地，仍保留明清時期水鄉風貌，姐姐們盡情購物，體驗古風遊船下午茶。及後換上旗袍，細味百年老店招牌菜「片皮蟹黃」，延續古色古香情懷。依婷、凱恩近距離親親水豚，並享用水豚造型的甜品，少女心大發！面對姐姐的熱情攻勢，水豚似有「投訴」？

programme.title: J Sport粵
programme.desc: 乒乓女將袁泳琪於殘特奧會摘雙打銅牌，她細談投身乒乓球原因，以及運動帶來的正面影響。林大輝中學於學界精英賽再有突破，六支不同運動的校隊成功入圍，眾人感受如何？女子花劍世界盃在港舉行，搜羅港將陳諾思與女團戰報。體育盛事可以帶動旅遊業，相關人士述說香港馬拉松衍生的經濟效益與環保元素。國際馬術盛典除了邀請冠軍級海外騎手，港將林立信、賴楨敏亦會參賽。青少年冰球賽集結多地隊伍比拼；慈善跑為兒童籌款，送上花絮。

programme.title: 勁歌金榜粵
programme.desc: 許文軒為觀眾倒數本星期「勁歌金榜」二十首上榜歌曲的排名位置，並相約新晉女團IdG Bubbles暢談音樂。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵 及 天氣報告粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 收藏卡牌市場活躍，除了零售亦衍生出，包括卡牌鑑定服務等其他生意，情況如何？金融市場變化莫測，投資者應該如何，為未來一年的投資組合做好部署？

programme.title: ABU亞太廣播聯盟音樂節2025粵
programme.desc: 為馬來西亞多部電視劇獻聲的NADEERA、土耳其歌手Orhan Cakmak、印度配音歌手Savani Ravindra Ghangurde、不丹歌唱大師Pema Samdrup，送上風格不同的歌曲，以音樂連結各地羣眾。此外，香港、澳門、日本、南韓都派出女歌手，演繹她們標誌性的作品，唱入人心。這年(2025)東道主蒙古則由樂團The HU Band做代表，採用呼麥唱法喊出獨樹一格的民族搖滾曲風。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 青衣有單位睡房玻璃現裂痕，管理公司拖延多月仍未動工；測量師拆解玻璃「自爆」原因。旺角街頭借錢黨再現，事主被騙現金外，附近生果店亦同樣有損失，事情來籠去脈如何？有駕駛者倒車時碰撞了後車一下，向後車提出賠償，對方卻報警，更錄口供指事主拒賠，事後更發函追討61萬損失！汽車保險顧問細說車輛碰撞後的處理方法。《聲秀》甄敏芳來自澳門，帶外景主持遊覽她熟悉的地方。郭富城到馬場出席活動，透露女兒想收到馬匹做禮物？

programme.title: 玩轉香港日與夜粵
programme.desc: 九龍西舊建築羣經活化後換上不同身份，延續使命，推動社區發展。昔日荔枝角醫院經歷逾百年風霜，變成推廣中華文化的園地。郭子豪、陳庭欣走進昔日工廠大廈，發揮藝術天份，試製玻璃器具。石硤尾初代公屋見證香港社會發展，莊思明、莊思敏入住其中，體驗獅子山堅毅精神。登後山俯瞰深水埗，萬家燈火熱鬧景象活現眼前；汝州街遍佈手作材料商店，成為女生週末最愛「蒲點」。鐵皮棚仔市集外表陳舊，竟是時裝設計師的尋寶聖地？

programme.title: 週六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 年輕人潮流觸角敏銳，愛好探索新事物、新資訊。踏入科技年代，青少年對新興電子產品、網絡流行媒體尤感興趣，追上時代步伐，已成新世代指標！主持開設《週六聊Teen谷》，會用盡所能搜羅世界各地至潮、至新情報，上至世界盛事、醫學百科、文藝與科技；下至日常生活、網絡熱搜，在每個星期六跟觀眾一一分享。論盡天南地北，暢談人氣熱話，「谷友」緊貼節目，便可輕鬆掌握全球脈搏動向。

programme.title: 全城一叮粵PG
programme.desc: 港人渴望外遊，黃建東藉着鬼馬的音樂唱作，帶大家遊勻全世界「識女仔」，還差點走過地府一趟？對手林子超在鋼管上「飛舞」，爆肌大跳高難度動作，全場血脈沸騰。他還衝破心理關口，坦蕩蕩面對胸口上的疤痕！第四輪對壘上演男女舞伴PK戰，黃瀅仴、吳兆麟透過舞蹈展示情侶從爭執到和好，還融入抬舉招式、小提琴元素。黃紫恩、劉展霆則變身小丑與小丑女，舞出極度瘋狂的愛情故事，玩得夠曳！雙方勢均力敵，勝負只差一分……

programme.title: 聲級學堂粵
programme.desc: 二十強學員投入第二階段配音訓練，認識日常生活的聲效技巧，喫麵、喝水，以至漱口、刷牙，原來都有竅門，導師們作正確示範，並點出學員常犯小錯誤。為配音打好基礎，必先戒除懶音陋習，翟耀輝老師傳授改善懶音速成班，齊來正視懶音！深入講解外語劇的配音難度，注意配合日、韓語的聲調與節奏，如何改善學員的「甩嘴」情況？發揮想像力，體驗旁白、廣告配音，有學員未能發揮水準，更淚灑當場……還會認識練習「數口」對配音的幫助。

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 阿塞拜疆拉伊奇的銅工藝經過加熱、敲打等工序，全憑有經驗的工匠的感覺製成。這工藝不止是藝術, 亦是他們的主要生計，更會出現在婚禮、餐桌上，與他們生活的各方面息息相關。

programme.title: 世界獨特社區粵普
programme.desc: 丹麥自由城是獨立運作的社區。擁有自己的法律、旗幟和獨特的生活方式。孕育了一個自由、民主和博愛精神世界。印度黎明之城 3300名來自世界各地的居民, 放棄了私有財產，貢獻自己的能力，為整個社區提供服務。

programme.title: 香港本色粵
programme.desc: 「糖妹」黃山怡深入本地蜂場和有機農場，瞭解同被列入本港首份非物質文化遺產的蜂蜜製作技藝及蔬菜種植技藝。蜂場老闆蕭偉龍如何獨力照顧逾百萬隻蜜蜂？採蜜的旺季為每年12月至4月，但淡季的時候，龍哥仍要比蜜蜂更勤力，才能維持蜂場運作！有機農場老闆佘常光年中無休，但收入只僅僅足夠維持一家生計，倘若政府拒絕續租農地，隨時血本無歸！糖妹隨龍哥走進種植節瓜、草莓等的田地，學習相關的種植知識。

programme.title: 香港本色粵
programme.desc: 粵劇的每個細節，均蘊藏深厚藝術底蘊。出生粵劇世家的高潤鴻，自幼隨父親學習敲擊樂，何以會與家族崗位背道而馳，轉投音樂組？要登上「正印花旦」或「文武生」之位，最少要十年時間，但謝曉瑩卻破舊立新，與丈夫高潤鴻創立新戲班，嶄露頭角即當上花旦。她娓娓道出昔日學戲趣事，一句「點解嘅？」何以是面對前輩的禁忌？頭飾設計師陳俊材和佈景師陳子詠分享入行經過和不同職位的注意事項。常置於後臺的木箱，藏着甚麼禁忌？

programme.title: 渣打香港馬拉松 2026 直擊直播粵
programme.desc: 香港馬拉松2026於1月18日(星期日)舉行，本年度賽事繼續設有全程馬拉松、半程馬拉松、十公里等不同距離的長跑比拼，參賽名額共有逾七萬個，屆時會有數以萬計的本地跑手與外地健將參與這項每年一道的體壇盛事。節目緊貼全馬的競逐，並由體育主持鍾志光、田徑專家葉啟德與港隊前代表黃暐璁，帶來專業評述。

programme.title: 渣打香港馬拉松 2026 直擊直播粵
programme.desc: 香港馬拉松2026於1月18日(星期日)舉行，本年度賽事繼續設有全程馬拉松、半程馬拉松、十公里等不同距離的長跑比拼，參賽名額共有逾七萬個，屆時會有數以萬計的本地跑手與外地健將參與這項每年一道的體壇盛事。節目緊貼全馬的競逐，並由體育主持鍾志光、田徑專家葉啟德與港隊前代表黃暐璁，帶來專業評述。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 奇蹟閃耀組與虹之咲為協助閃亮宿堂採購新書，來到位於書店街的時幸堂。在這家神祕書店內，未來們遇到一名叫小明的神祕少女，她不但帶領奇蹟閃耀組遊覽時幸堂，更協助虹之咲找尋她以前看過的繪本《寶石王國的公主》。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 奇蹟閃耀組獲邀參加火箭發射的倒數活動，而活動開始前，她們在宇宙主題樂園四處遊覽，學習了許多關於宇宙的知識，更與導遊星星姐姐成為朋友。但是，就在參觀途中，未來竟大意按到發射火箭的按鈕，被關在火箭裡……

programme.title: 愛犬訊號粵日
programme.desc: 未祐在之介寵物診所主持幼犬訓練課程的同時，也開始在「Proud Dog」負責初學者的訓練，事業的順利，讓未祐開始建立出作為馴犬師的自信。然而，身為師父的丹羽，卻對未祐與薩築的情況感到疑慮……

programme.title: 愛犬訊號粵日
programme.desc: 在某次訓練中，薩築憤而咬傷未祐，丹羽見狀便暫時託管薩築，並叫未祐暫時不用上班。對於薩築反抗的原因，未祐一時毫無頭緒，但在回顧自己與母親的關係時，卻突然意識到自己某句說話，可能無意中傷害了薩築。

programme.title: 出走澳洲粵
programme.desc: 來到墨爾本亞拉河谷，二人一起劃獨木舟，慢活享受美景，永城還細談夢想中的婚禮。為了學習照顧樹熊，他們先尋找尤加利葉，更參與拯救樹熊BB行動！翠如發現澳洲「馬國明」，隨即安排牠與港產馬明「見面」？主持們分道揚鑣，各自相約友人到斐茲洛伊花園晨運。翠如及後往設於城市天台的蜂蜜養殖場，品嚐新鮮蜂蜜。永城則到咖啡街，一嘆被喻為「世上最好喝」的咖啡。二人於水族館再聚，永城更會潛入水族館魚缸內，與鯊魚近距離接觸！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 馬介休由鱈魚鹽醃而成，可運用燒、燴、焗等不同做法炮製出葡式佳餚。肥媽這次以馬介休與薯仔的絕妙配搭，先燴煮香濃惹味的「番茄薯仔燴馬介休」；及後再呈獻「馬介休鴛鴦薯絲」，炸薯絲及炒薯絲帶來脆、爽雙重口感！「西班牙炒飯」材料豐富，步驟繁多，是否難以挑戰？肥媽教家庭觀眾輕鬆煮出這道內外兼備的美食。除了幾道異國美食之外，肥媽還藉着「鴛鴦蒜子雞湯」展示中菜好滋味。「每日一飲」，奉上可舒緩喉嚨痛的「鹹柑桔水」。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 芝士專門店內出售荷蘭優質芝士，加入薰衣草、黑松露、小茴等做成的各款新派芝士令人目不暇給，阿媽決定「掃貨」炮製「芝」味全餐！芝士「皮」多會被棄掉，肥媽物盡其用，用之煮成「芝士雜菜牛骨湯」。她還把紫色、綠色、黃色的椰菜花先煎後焗，巧製素菜扒，賣相吸引。想在家中自製「芝士火鍋」？阿媽「教路」，簡單易學。她又DIY芝心批－ 「焗酥皮牛肉環」，外脆內軟。6號則奉上有養顏功效的「海燕窩鮮百合奶露」，孝敬肥媽。

programme.title: 令人心動的OFFER普
programme.desc: 節目走進香港律政體系和大律師職業，由數位來自不同背景、懷抱夢想的法學生在帶教大律師的引領下，經歷為期一月的實習生活。他們通過圍繞普通法和大陸法兩大法系設計的八大課題考驗，爭奪兩個成為大律師的offer。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 男生為「My Little Show」表演彈琴，他會彈奏一首舞曲，並希望以愉快的旋律帶動觀眾。四人一組的女生則以跳舞傳遞歡樂，她們伴隨節拍感十足的音樂，送上融入側手翻、���字馬的高難度舞蹈，演出相當精彩。人生總是會遇上困擾或感到軟弱的時候，結他導師特意彈出<陪我長大和<喝采，並與主持姐姐一同以歌聲，為大家帶來心靈慰藉。此外，他還會介紹一款雙琴頸結他，有甚麼獨特之處？

programme.title: 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之海底探險隊粵普
programme.desc: 大海對孩子們來說總有著無限的吸引力，海底深處到底是什麼樣的？存活著哪些動物？它們的生存本領是什麼？一支神祕的海底探險隊正在悄悄集結，將帶著各種各樣的問題去海洋裡尋找答案。

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之海底探險隊粵普
programme.desc: 大海對孩子們來說總有著無限的吸引力，海底深處到底是什麼樣的？存活著哪些動物？它們的生存本領是什麼？一支神祕的海底探險隊正在悄悄集結，將帶著各種各樣的問題去海洋裡尋找答案。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子渴望《阿拉丁》故事裡的神燈，後來逛市集時遇到一個售價不菲的殘舊油燈，爺爺依然將它買下。濱治羨慕花輪有英叔貼心服侍，於是與小丸子一起帶同自己的爺爺，往花輪家向英叔拜師學做管家。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 這十年幸福中國粵
programme.desc: 本片從城市到鄉村，以科技、社會、民生、體育、文化等多個角度出發，用小故事展現大主題、用小視角透視大時代，記錄各行各業普通人的工作與生活，體現幸福是奮鬥出來的思想。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠臺每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 星期日檔案粵
programme.desc: 近年港人北上消費成為風氣，除了喫喝玩樂，亦多了人往內地學習騎馬。有家長每逢週末，帶子女參加騎馬訓練課程，亦有人找私人教練，組成旅行團往返內地多個城市，體驗策騎樂趣。北上騎馬對他們來說，究竟有甚麼吸引力？又會帶來甚麼改變？

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」瞭解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 保濟丸130 週年呈獻:中年好聲音4粵
programme.desc: 駐唱歌手縱抱恙仍要評審<聽我唱歌，能否憑這臺語歌晉級？有參賽者挑戰高難度的<李香蘭，谷婭溦提醒她留意唱歌的空間感。美國選手跟海選時一樣選唱<Halo，肥媽坦言其表現失準。有參賽者「甩嘴」，阿媽笑指是因看到海兒而受驚，令「女神」一臉無奈。創作歌手望憑<命硬出線，可會如願？前歌手可嵐情感呼喊<你是你本身的傳奇，某評審提到她在訴說自身故事。駐場歌手<身騎白馬闖關，獲添Sir稱為「馬國周深」！

programme.title: 華潤集團呈獻：無窮之路V — 智行無疆粵普
programme.desc: 「甬舟號」盾構機正挑戰世界最長海底高鐵隧道 -- 金塘海底隧道，其刀盤設計可抵抗12級颱風；寧波「三橋一隧」聯控中心展現超級工程背後的數位化管控系統，見證中國基建的智慧化轉型。

programme.title: Leafgel Premium 呈獻:一週星星粵
programme.desc: 「鬆鬆姐姐」陳松伶已入行四十年？原來要從一個模仿大賽計起！她更會特地辦一次紀念演唱會，務求勾起歌迷舊有的回憶，音樂總監卻由觀眾認識不久的張與辰出任？與辰大讚鬆鬆姐姐是個「有溫度」的人，此話何解？兩人還即席送上<松伶和<分分鐘需要你。另一位於背後支持鬆鬆姐姐的是丈夫張鐸，有指女方將財產全給男方處理？結婚近十六年仍未辦婚禮？本尊即席接受Fact Check！鬆鬆更揭初認識對方時，自己被誤會是男人？

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈獻:準備唱錢粵
programme.desc: 唱歌與遊戲愛好者、明星級選手集結，《準備唱錢》挑戰音準、拍子。主持兼音樂總監Eric Kwok與音樂人、工程部團隊聯手打造音準分析系統，過程中遇到甚麼考驗？經過「中音」學員配合測試，還要制定非一般遊戲規則，究竟《唱錢》有幾好玩？除了九隻可愛吉祥物「Sing豆」，舞臺佈景、燈光設計上亦注入音樂元素，進一步帶動刺激遊戲體驗。主持森美、Eric、李茵彤與參賽者親友屆時現場應援，見證挑戰者向十萬獎金進發！

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 一對夫婦由熟客搖身一變成為餐廳東主，傳承前老闆孃的手藝，親手炮製山東墨魚餃、生炸豬扒擔擔麵等佳餚，別具風味。鼎爺探訪一間粵菜食府，品嚐工序繁複的秋梨枇杷東坡肉、養生的當歸燒大鱔，並細說烹調這些菜式的相關知識。「Man姐」佘詩曼推介「人氣」居酒屋，獨創招牌左口魚煲仔飯，魚肉鮮香，搭配鹹香飯焦，堪稱完美組合。的士司機樂哥帶暉哥「飲夜茶」，品嚐鵪鶉蛋燒賣、無骨鹽香雞等點心佳餚，選擇豐富，盡享美味！

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 渣打香港馬拉松2026 一起．跑更遠粵
programme.desc: 香港馬拉松2026於1月18日圓滿舉行，本年度賽事繼續設有全程馬拉松、半程馬拉松、十公里等不同距離的長跑比拼，參賽名額共有逾七萬個，意味數以萬計的本地跑手與外地健兒會參與這項每年一道的體壇盛事。節目剪輯全馬等不同賽事的激烈競逐，體育主持鍾志光聯同田徑專家葉啟德、港隊前代表黃暐璁提供專業評述。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 大師級大觀園粵英PG
programme.desc: 本節目製作單位與國際頂級博物館和藝廊合作，以沉浸式電影加上具代表性的歷史學家和藝評家的講解，讓觀眾觀賞世界知名的藝術作品。

programme.title: 科學一眼看清粵英
programme.desc: 《科學一眼看清》旨在讓每個人都能接觸到科學！透過簡單的實驗、有趣的軼事和壯觀的視覺效果，回到過去，瞭解最偉大科學家的生活，瞭解他們的發明如何改變我們的世界。

programme.title: 芬蘭潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 回到芬蘭首都赫爾辛基，必玩焗桑拿、跳海體驗。帽子品牌以環保為理念，將無用的布料升級再造，深受當地人支持！品嚐熊肉、馴鹿肉料理之後，芷珮到服飾家品品牌特賣場掃平貨。由芬蘭乘船往愛沙尼亞只需兩小時，郵輪上設有商店、自助餐區，不知不覺便抵達目的地。塔林古城區被列為世界文化遺產，芷珮逛小店、喝啤酒配熱湯；及後換上十五世紀服裝參觀歷史悠久的藥房，祕探古老藥方。電視塔上開設了環迴景觀餐廳，讓人歎着佳餚賞美景！

programme.title: 到此一遊 臺北粵
programme.desc: 由嘉義到臺北開設分店的雞肉飯名店，擁有逾四十年歷史；據悉還深受臺星小S喜愛，到底有多滋味？Albert引領敏之品嚐創意臺菜，雪糕造型的鮑魚前菜，已令人按捺不住要「打卡呃Like」！臺灣不少人是「邊爐愛好者」，地道熱選「酸菜白肉鍋」可合兩位主持的口味？馬英九、李安等均曾光顧的私房中菜，有名人「加持」，出品當然出色。二人及後轉換口味，西餐廳只提供牛扒、龍蝦等三款主菜選擇，足見大廚對選料、廚藝的自信。

programme.title: 出走澳洲粵
programme.desc: 來到墨爾本亞拉河谷，二人一起劃獨木舟，慢活享受美景，永城還細談夢想中的婚禮。為了學習照顧樹熊，他們先尋找尤加利葉，更參與拯救樹熊BB行動！翠如發現澳洲「馬國明」，隨即安排牠與港產馬明「見面」？主持們分道揚鑣，各自相約友人到斐茲洛伊花園晨運。翠如及後往設於城市天台的蜂蜜養殖場，品嚐新鮮蜂蜜。永城則到咖啡街，一嘆被喻為「世上最好喝」的咖啡。二人於水族館再聚，永城更會潛入水族館魚缸內，與鯊魚近距離接觸！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 馬介休由鱈魚鹽醃而成，可運用燒、燴、焗等不同做法炮製出葡式佳餚。肥媽這次以馬介休與薯仔的絕妙配搭，先燴煮香濃惹味的「番茄薯仔燴馬介休」；及後再呈獻「馬介休鴛鴦薯絲」，炸薯絲及炒薯絲帶來脆、爽雙重口感！「西班牙炒飯」材料豐富，步驟繁多，是否難以挑戰？肥媽教家庭觀眾輕鬆煮出這道內外兼備的美食。除了幾道異國美食之外，肥媽還藉着「鴛鴦蒜子雞湯」展示中菜好滋味。「每日一飲」，奉上可舒緩喉嚨痛的「鹹柑桔水」。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 芝士專門店內出售荷蘭優質芝士，加入薰衣草、黑松露、小茴等做成的各款新派芝士令人目不暇給，阿媽決定「掃貨」炮製「芝」味全餐！芝士「皮」多會被棄掉，肥媽物盡其用，用之煮成「芝士雜菜牛骨湯」。她還把紫色、綠色、黃色的椰菜花先煎後焗，巧製素菜扒，賣相吸引。想在家中自製「芝士火鍋」？阿媽「教路」，簡單易學。她又DIY芝心批－ 「焗酥皮牛肉環」，外脆內軟。6號則奉上有養顏功效的「海燕窩鮮百合奶露」，孝敬肥媽。

programme.title: 閨密教煮粵
programme.desc: Liza姐駕到，Jade自信自己的「洋蔥湯」、「紅梅汁焗豬柳」、「紅桑梅芝士蛋糕」絕不會令其失望。Liza姐回首演藝生涯、分享與家英哥的夫妻相處之道，更一探側田口風，讓他交待感情狀況、說出婚姻態度。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#19粵
programme.desc: 有朋自覺身體出現退化，上司要求他參加廚藝比賽，有朋道出擔心自己退化影響家人。妙喜提議有朋與蕙婷參個「九死一生」比賽，有朋參加比賽，卻發現只不過是為老人家設的活動，高慶發現有朋的「退化」另有原因。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#30粵普
programme.desc: 二孃解決王劉氏，重掌事權，十一娘得知此事後也鬆了一口氣；宮中準備舉辦壽宴，在民間徵集繡品，十一娘請世顯臨摹百壽圖的底稿；文姨娘利用諭哥和諄哥引開十一娘，趁機燒毀萬壽圖，十一娘於是攜天之四靈圖進宮。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 順德河鮮固然鮮味十足，另一款同樣馳名的特產鯪魚乾，卻有着截然不同的家鄉風味。鼎爺將鯪魚乾加入臘味煲仔飯，味道份外甘香可口。不過，烹調鯪魚忌下薑宜用蒜。此外，如想煮出飯焦，還要把煲仔四邊打斜各燒一分鐘！鼎爺注重養生進補，這次更一口氣帶來名貴的姬松茸、羊肚菌和蟲草花，配以滋補十足的本地烏雞，燉煮「三菌青邊鮑燉烏雞湯」，補上加補！鼎爺又應阿譚要求，即做「雙芹炒螺片」，並詳盡講解令螺片爽口彈牙的竅門。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 除了吸煙，空氣污染、油煙等都是肺癌的風險因素，專科醫生提醒本港不少機構有推行肺癌篩查計劃，並詳析檢查方法，但為何要高度關注非吸煙的女性？醫生還為關注健康的港人帶來相關建議。龔嘉欣身穿白裙到場，預告《在家宴客60道菜》從肥媽、李家鼎以及五大名廚身上學到的新知識，還逐一細談跟眾名廚的相處點滴。受訪其間，她突然笑指大王離題談起感情事？「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓選用三文魚頭與大魚頭，奉上煲仔菜「金銀魚頭煲」。

programme.title: 健康必殺食粵PG
programme.desc: 男士最忌「頭耷耷」，甚麼食物有助重振雄風？生蠔含豐富鋅質，被視為壯陽恩物，六號、衍峯聯同馮盈盈、何依婷直闖蠔場「進補」。生蠔經過曬乾會成為金蠔、蠔豉，過程中可會令營養流失？湛錦鈿將金蠔配以乳酪沙律、薄脆，煮出創意打卡美饌。茄紅素有助減低患前列腺癌的風險，黃婧靈、林凱恩向兩位男主持推介天堂果，還在農場即摘即喫。另一名廚陳國強用天堂果入饌，並帶來豬腰好餸，讓男士們補腰補腎！此外，牛油果也與壯陽有關？

programme.title: 陪著你走#12粵
programme.desc: 天從發覺導生沒有任何反應，獸醫懷疑牠可能腳傷痛至暈倒，須留醫觀察，言重暫時充當天從的手杖和導生。秀玄被取消工作，心情惡劣。何娜向天從說出對秀玄的看法，得天從鼓勵。導生髖關節退化，不能再擔任導盲犬……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 由於測驗分數欠佳，小丸子在媽媽安排下，參加暑假補習堂。雖然小丸子起初興致缺缺，但代課老師卻令她超乎想像，她為人溫柔之餘，連藤木的勞作功課也細心指導，小丸子與藤木很快就喜歡上她，可是……

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 全球氣溫為何會越來越暖？這集「Kids’ Notes」，氣候變化博物館大使以「被子」作比喻，指人類活動令被子變厚，為氣候帶來深遠影響，極端天氣出現的頻率亦有所增加。地球溫度持續上升，長遠會對農業、生態、人類健康等方面衍生甚麼問題？小朋友可減少不必要的用電、多乘公共交通工具，試從減碳着手改善全球暖化。嘉賓還提到一種新式能源氫能，用來發電會比化石燃料更合適？另會送上AI生成動畫《白鴿和螞蟻》的上半部。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 放暑假，其他人都出門遊玩，百無聊賴的大雄想到去未來世界走走，到達後卻發現四周空無一人。大雄連番遭遇不幸，連多啦A夢也看不過眼，於是派出「萬事得蜜蜂」，暗中替大雄解決一切難題。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 週年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 豪宅升溫，二手業主也加快放盤，掃管笏一間近2,500平方呎洋房，樓價走勢如何？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠臺每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2726粵
programme.desc: 力蓮出席酒會遭人嘲笑，因聲音沙啞未能還擊，於是命鐵手代勞。怎料鐵手突然失控，口出惡言，令力蓮大感尷尬。鐵手及後解釋，他之所以出醜，原來另有隱情。力蓮發現鐵手極易受人影響，遂要鐡手學習他人尖酸刻薄的「Mean人」技巧，並代替暫時失去「戰鬥力」的她發聲。鐵手付出不少努力，終於「出口成Mean」。然而，鐵手「學壞」後得罪了不少人，內心痛苦不已。璟風提出一個解決方法，鐵手照辦，詎料……

programme.title: 非常檢控觀#1粵PG
programme.desc: 檢控官包希仁成功檢控本港首宗無屍體、無法證、無認罪的殺人案被告，卻因某些緣故設法令案件重審，令死者的女兒認為他偏幫被告，怒擲骨灰盅洩忿……五年後，黑幫老大鄧車堡遭仇家尋仇，路過的希仁縱沒受傷卻被送院診治。車堡的手下展熊飛知悉希仁患有鏡反射觸覺症，能感受別人的痛楚。車堡存活下來，熊飛的手下楊文頂卻代罪而死，文頂的好友白逸桐遷怒熊飛。熊飛打算為文頂討回公道，但拒與希仁合作。希仁懷疑仇殺事件另有內情……

programme.title: 宿敵契約#20粵普PG
programme.desc: 慕容仲訛稱平城病重，引隨歌進宮；阿曜從後刺殺隨歌，並將其埋葬。如嫣目睹一切，馬上告知一笑。凌峯表示要帶隨歌到風雨盟才能救治；在眾人犧牲下，一笑順利帶隨歌到風雨盟。靜炎告訴戲陽其父兄已死，戲陽傷心欲絕。

programme.title: 聚大金鳳呈獻:在家宴客60道菜粵
programme.desc: 肥媽打頭陣呈獻胡椒蟹，示範香料運用的祕訣外，更分享以牛油增香兼收汁的技巧。龔嘉欣其間被阿媽追問戀情，顯得難以招架。菠蘿咕嚕肉是常見小菜，邵德龍師傅卻帶來刁鑽版。豬腩肉於兩次油炸中間要取出放水中煮，有何妙用？「幟哥」黃永幟把金蠔與生蠔共冶一爐，帶來「富蠔」的宴客精選，嘉欣大讚加入膶腸令味道層次昇華。為照顧不同客人的口味，宴席上準備一道素菜是體貼安排，大家不妨參考「鼎爺」李家鼎指導嘉欣炮製的錦繡如意。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
名媛望族#25粵PG
programme.desc: 木水被送院，醫生指他未知何時醒來。日輝向爾嫣透露將回英國。啟燁告知卓萬爾嫣與日輝的事，卓萬找日輝；另啟燁把日輝打至重傷。爾嫣要與卓萬重頭開始，卓萬直言心中有刺。日輝左腳需切除，被救時手緊握卓萬呔夾。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 除了吸煙，空氣污染、油煙等都是肺癌的風險因素，專科醫生提醒本港不少機構有推行肺癌篩查計劃，並詳析檢查方法，但為何要高度關注非吸煙的女性？醫生還為關注健康的港人帶來相關建議。龔嘉欣身穿白裙到場，預告《在家宴客60道菜》從肥媽、李家鼎以及五大名廚身上學到的新知識，還逐一細談跟眾名廚的相處點滴。受訪其間，她突然笑指大王離題談起感情事？「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓選用三文魚頭與大魚頭，奉上煲仔菜「金銀魚頭煲」。

programme.title: 健康必殺食粵PG
programme.desc: 男士最忌「頭耷耷」，甚麼食物有助重振雄風？生蠔含豐富鋅質，被視為壯陽恩物，六號、衍峯聯同馮盈盈、何依婷直闖蠔場「進補」。生蠔經過曬乾會成為金蠔、蠔豉，過程中可會令營養流失？湛錦鈿將金蠔配以乳酪沙律、薄脆，煮出創意打卡美饌。茄紅素有助減低患前列腺癌的風險，黃婧靈、林凱恩向兩位男主持推介天堂果，還在農場即摘即喫。另一名廚陳國強用天堂果入饌，並帶來豬腰好餸，讓男士們補腰補腎！此外，牛油果也與壯陽有關？

programme.title: 陪著你走#12粵
programme.desc: 天從發覺導生沒有任何反應，獸醫懷疑牠可能腳傷痛至暈倒，須留醫觀察，言重暫時充當天從的手杖和導生。秀玄被取消工作，心情惡劣。何娜向天從說出對秀玄的看法，得天從鼓勵。導生髖關節退化，不能再擔任導盲犬……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#19粵
programme.desc: 有朋自覺身體出現退化，上司要求他參加廚藝比賽，有朋道出擔心自己退化影響家人。妙喜提議有朋與蕙婷參個「九死一生」比賽，有朋參加比賽，卻發現只不過是為老人家設的活動，高慶發現有朋的「退化」另有原因。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#30粵普
programme.desc: 二孃解決王劉氏，重掌事權，十一娘得知此事後也鬆了一口氣；宮中準備舉辦壽宴，在民間徵集繡品，十一娘請世顯臨摹百壽圖的底稿；文姨娘利用諭哥和諄哥引開十一娘，趁機燒毀萬壽圖，十一娘於是攜天之四靈圖進宮。

programme.title: 呱張爆音團
programme.desc: 12歲的柯阿瑞和他的三個好朋友一起在車庫裡成立了一支樂隊，但是很快的他們就發現他們的樂隊很爛-真的很爛。問題不在他們的音樂或是百變造型，而是因為柯阿瑞寫不出歌詞。他就是想不出酷炫的歌詞嘛，直到......柯阿瑞找到了他姊姊翠娜的日記。「哇！這裡面不只廢話連篇，還有滿滿的青少年煩惱。」柯阿瑞和樂隊「祕密的」用翠娜最新的日記作為他們的創作新曲的歌詞–結果你知道怎麼樣嗎？效果真是棒到要大叫嗷嗷嗷，當然演出機會也越來越多了！這樣一來就皆大歡喜了，對嗎？纔怪。翠娜是個超級討人厭的恰查某，完全無法忍受她弟弟的爛樂隊比她還要紅。她想盡辦法要來粉碎他們的夢想。但沒關係啦。柯阿瑞很瞭解他姊姊，嗯...就像姊姊肚子裡的蛔蟲一樣。柯阿瑞總是知道該怎麼做才能讓翠娜炸毛，然後生出他們最欠缺的東西......歌詞！快跟著柯阿瑞和他的樂團嗨翻天吧！看他們為達目的怎麼不擇手段的惡搞翠娜的玻璃心世界吧！

programme.title: 森林偵探
programme.desc: 韓國教育電視臺EBS製作的寓教於樂卡通，可輕鬆認識大自然的樣貌。神祕事件在森林裡發生，栗子莫名消失，昆蟲朋友離奇失蹤，皮特、巴巴、茉莉對這些事件展開調查。帶著偵探精神一起度過難關，在繁忙的調查過程中，共同學習、共同成長，創造學習樂趣。

programme.title: 紳士與小姐
programme.desc: 【韓國收視破38%韓版《真善美》重拾幸福時光】《我唯一的守護者》編劇金始慶最新家庭劇新作，與爸爸、繼母一同生活的直率女孩樸丹丹，因繼兄繼母闖禍被詐騙，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面對爸爸的偏坦對待，樸丹丹憤而離家，因緣際會下來到有錢人家擔任住宿教師，陪伴失去母親的三個孩子，而他們的爸爸便是高冷霸道總裁李英國，在妻子早逝後，英國的內心漸漸封閉，與孩子間也產生隔閡，好在天真浪漫的樸丹丹出現，加上孩子們的湊合，幸福將再次降臨。

programme.title: 好搭檔
programme.desc: 【張娜拉火力全開！槓上小三、手撕出軌老公超過癮】王牌律師遇上菜鳥新人，一場法庭與情感的雙重對決即將展開！《好搭檔》講述擁有17年經驗的離婚律師車恩京，在面對丈夫背叛後，與熱血正義的新人韓宥利成為「最不可能搭檔」的辦公室火花組合。冷麪魔頭與理想主義者，兩人從互看不順眼，到聯手應對一樁樁離婚官司，解開婚姻背後的人性兩難。冷靜與熱血交織，掀起一場場心碎又痛快的離婚風暴！

programme.title: 男朋友
programme.desc: 【韓版《羅馬假期》霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男樸寶劍】出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情、步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界。兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離。多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工。過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延。她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖。愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 好搭檔
programme.desc: 【張娜拉火力全開！槓上小三、手撕出軌老公超過癮】王牌律師遇上菜鳥新人，一場法庭與情感的雙重對決即將展開！《好搭檔》講述擁有17年經驗的離婚律師車恩京，在面對丈夫背叛後，與熱血正義的新人韓宥利成為「最不可能搭檔」的辦公室火花組合。冷麪魔頭與理想主義者，兩人從互看不順眼，到聯手應對一樁樁離婚官司，解開婚姻背後的人性兩難。冷靜與熱血交織，掀起一場場心碎又痛快的離婚風暴！

programme.title: 紳士與小姐
programme.desc: 【韓國收視破38%韓版《真善美》重拾幸福時光】《我唯一的守護者》編劇金始慶最新家庭劇新作，與爸爸、繼母一同生活的直率女孩樸丹丹，因繼兄繼母闖禍被詐騙，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面對爸爸的偏坦對待，樸丹丹憤而離家，因緣際會下來到有錢人家擔任住宿教師，陪伴失去母親的三個孩子，而他們的爸爸便是高冷霸道總裁李英國，在妻子早逝後，英國的內心漸漸封閉，與孩子間也產生隔閡，好在天真浪漫的樸丹丹出現，加上孩子們的湊合，幸福將再次降臨。

programme.title: 奇蹟的兄弟
programme.desc: 【《高斯電子公司》裴賢聖不當高富帥，與《精神教練諸葛吉》鄭宇奇蹟相遇】負債累累的熱血青年陸東柱，在以為是人生中最糟糕的一天遇上了特殊神力卻來歷不明名為「奇蹟」的少年。能夠深刻感受別人痛苦與絕望，也能治癒別人。為找回他的過去與記憶，兩人成為了彼此生命中的一個奇蹟相遇。

programme.title: 向風而行
programme.desc: 【《請叫我總監》譚松韻與《清平樂》王凱，飛向天際攜手築夢！！】鷺洲航空客運飛行部副部長顧南亭因公司改制，與性格颯爽不羈的程霄成為上下屬和師徒關係。面對接踵而來的突發航空事件，追求穩定秩序的顧南亭時常被不按常理出牌的程霄打亂計劃，共同經歷衝擊與考驗，一路披荊斬棘、相扶成長。

programme.title: 時光之城
programme.desc: 【橫跨兩國人氣演員的偶像劇，張哲瀚攜手樸敏英初嘗試愛情羅曼史！！】樂觀積極的元氣少女許真，在前往蓋亞影視應徵時撞見了當紅炸子雞顧持鈞被前女友拒絕的場面。不希望丟臉的事情曝光的顧持鈞則從中作梗想趕走許真，卻陰錯陽差的在蓋亞集團二公子林晉修的幫助下，反而成為了顧持鈞的助理。朝夕相處、情愫蔓延，卻同時捲入了集團的陰謀，兩人要如何逃出危機，讓有情人終成眷屬呢?

programme.title: 愛情是Beautiful，人生是Wonderful
programme.desc: 【《月水金火木土》金宰永攜手《社內相親》薛仁雅尋找幸福小確幸！！！】清雅是一名放棄戀愛和結婚，努力在生活中，連續八年準備警察公務員卻無法合格的社會小螺絲。俊輝則是一名對他人毫無興趣的不婚主義者，不管是愛情、友情還是親情都秉持N分之一的態度。認識了彼此開始尋找瑣碎但現實的小確幸，並開始認知愛情是美好的人生是精彩的。

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷麪戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 媽媽要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任勞任怨大半輩子的慈母覺醒切割貪財不孝子】因丈夫早逝，獨自撫養四名子女的尹正愛，就如同天下所有的媽媽一樣，為了孩子總是願意犧牲自己，一路從路邊的菜販打拼，多年後與大女兒允姬開了間點心餐廳。正當一切都看似幸福美滿時，孩子們的婚姻、事業、學業紛紛出現狀況，在面對問題時兒女們總持相反意見，並只貪圖母親的遺產，讓正愛深感背叛，在朋友的勸說下，正愛打算不再以孩子為生活重心，並在緣分安排下開始了第二春。

programme.title: 追蹤者
programme.desc: 【國稅廳版文森佐任時完熱血復仇】全臺首播，任職於頂尖會計事務所的黃東柱，實力超羣，年紀輕輕就坐上組長的位子，在父親墜海身亡以意外結案後，整理遺物的東柱發現，紀錄大企業逃稅的本子憑空消失了，他火速考上地方國稅局。靠著揭發知名球星的逃稅案，立馬成為國稅局的當紅炸子雞，本以為能離真相更近，卻被調職到「國稅廳5局」，這個被大家稱作垃圾場的單位，而他又該如何率領團隊深入調查，找到真正的殺父仇人呢?

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 追蹤者
programme.desc: 【國稅廳版文森佐任時完熱血復仇】全臺首播，任職於頂尖會計事務所的黃東柱，實力超羣，年紀輕輕就坐上組長的位子，在父親墜海身亡以意外結案後，整理遺物的東柱發現，紀錄大企業逃稅的本子憑空消失了，他火速考上地方國稅局。靠著揭發知名球星的逃稅案，立馬成為國稅局的當紅炸子雞，本以為能離真相更近，卻被調職到「國稅廳5局」，這個被大家稱作垃圾場的單位，而他又該如何率領團隊深入調查，找到真正的殺父仇人呢?

programme.title: 歐若拉公主

programme.title: 媽媽要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任勞任怨大半輩子的慈母覺醒切割貪財不孝子】因丈夫早逝，獨自撫養四名子女的尹正愛，就如同天下所有的媽媽一樣，為了孩子總是願意犧牲自己，一路從路邊的菜販打拼，多年後與大女兒允姬開了間點心餐廳。正當一切都看似幸福美滿時，孩子們的婚姻、事業、學業紛紛出現狀況，在面對問題時兒女們總持相反意見，並只貪圖母親的遺產，讓正愛深感背叛，在朋友的勸說下，正愛打算不再以孩子為生活重心，並在緣分安排下開始了第二春。

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真兇！！】最強正義檢察官樸政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人。為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真兇，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中。

programme.title: 依法相愛吧
programme.desc: 【李昇基×李世榮二次合作，青梅竹馬譜出律政羅曼史！！】改編自人氣網路小說，「怪物天才檢察官」金正浩與「韓國小姐出身律師」金琉璃，青梅竹馬重逢後，一起經營「LawCafé」的故事。既是律師事務所、又是咖啡館的小天地裡，用溫暖的飲品與犀利的法律智慧，幫助無數人伸張正義。從法庭到日常，辯論化為鬥嘴，正義化為浪漫，療癒又甜蜜的愛情由此展開。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道總裁《飛狐外傳》林雨申戀上俏鄰居《光芒》蔡文靜！】吳憂因車禍意外放男友鴿子慘遭分手，而同樣在這場車禍中喪命的是雅曼生物科技總裁何西亞的未婚妻陸芸。吳憂分手後寄情於工作，投入新職場認識了陸芸的妹妹陸蔓，成為了閨蜜。在公事上與何西亞有了合作，不打不相識的這對歡喜冤家，好不容易發展成為戀人,此時發現陸芸在他們之間串連起來的緣分…

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真兇！！】最強正義檢察官樸政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人。為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真兇，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中。

programme.title: 步步驚心
programme.desc: 那一天，張曉的命運被一場車禍徹底改寫。她眼看著那輛失控的卡車將自己的靈魂撞出了軀體，而她，既沒有進醫院也沒有進天堂，卻是被撞進了清朝的宮廷中。就像鋪天蓋地的穿越小說裏寫的那樣，張曉的靈魂跨過時間的隧道，在一個叫馬爾泰.若曦的十六歲清朝女孩的體內，重生了…時年，康熙第四十三。天下太平，但一場震動歷史的「九龍奪嫡」正在暗潮湧動。權利的廝殺，愛情的灼燒，在被無限放大的歷史舞臺上，張曉，不，是馬爾泰•若曦的命運無可避免的與眾位親王阿哥們交織在一起…她知道自己不該捲入這場九王奪嫡的爭鬥中，可心不由己，因為這裡有她所愛的，也有愛著她的…若曦最後選擇的究竟是溫潤如玉的八阿哥，還是面冷心熱的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人?等歷史的風雲過後，可以陪她看夕陽西下、雲捲雲舒的又將是誰？

programme.title: 紅天機(完)
programme.desc: 【國民妹妹金裕貞，百搭安孝燮x孔明x郭時暘眾多男神演員！！】朝鮮時代進入景福宮的絕世美女畫工紅天機（金裕貞飾），和失明但可以讀懂天空和星座的觀象監河覽（安孝燮飾），風流倜儻的亮明大君（孔明飾)，夢想成為王的周向大君(郭時暘飾)，掌握生死的三神及被封印人類的魔王同時存在展開的奇幻愛情古裝劇。

programme.title: Baby Einstein - Baby Newton: All About Shapes
programme.desc: With the Dolittle, and other Baby programs under their belts, the tots who follow Julie Aigner-Clark's Baby Einstein series will sidle up to Baby Newton expecting a similar exploration of building blocks to brilliance, but this time there's a wrinkle or two. Animation makes its first appearance, and parents steeped in keep-it-simple culture may object to the springy "I Know My Shapes" song, a departure from classical-only video predecessors.

programme.title: The Deep
programme.desc: March 1984, a few miles off the south coast of Iceland, a fishing boat sank with all its men. One of the crew members miraculously survived. After six hours in the ocean, the exhausted man is washed ashore, only to find himself on a deadly lava field.

programme.desc: Supertato's Tato belt gets locked inside a glass case for an exhibition, but Tomato can't remember the code to get it out again, and Supertato needs it back to defeat Evil Pea.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Double Trouble
programme.desc: Supertato and Carrot are looking for ice and think Evil Pea has become kind by giving them some. They soon realise it's not Evil Pea after all.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Stuck
programme.desc: All of the Teletubbies are stuck. Tinky Winky's hand is stuck in the bag, Dipsy's hat is stuck, Laa-Laa's ball is stuck and Po is stuck on the Tubby Slidey!

programme.title: Yakka Dee (S7) - V
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'v', and they go on an adventure around the sound. We see a van and a volcano, and meet a violet violin!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S2) - Sneezy Wheezy
programme.desc: Everyone in OKIDO has been kept awake by a mysterious sound. Messy and his friends go to find its source and discover that the giants need their help.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops (S1) - Top Fun
programme.desc: Preston needs Mojo's racer top speed to get his new plane off the ground. But when his flight goes wrong, Mojo and Bo have to take to the air in Mojo's jet top to help him down!

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Musical Statues
programme.desc: At the end of a long day, Bluey and her family are out of sync and out of sorts, so Mum gets everyone to play musical statues.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Fairy Tale
programme.desc: Dad tells Bluey and Bingo a real-life fairy tale about growing up in a wild place called the '80s, about a boy who was cursed when he was mean to his little brother.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The World Record
programme.desc: The Squirrels want to get a World Record, but in what? And Duggee is too busy to help. "If only we had more Duggee's" muses Tag. Which gives Norrie a record-breaking idea...

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Rollercoaster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels build the best rollercoaster anyone ever saw. From a sweet song, to spinning through a helix, and getting the full G-force, it's a ride Duggee's going to remember!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - What's Hot?
programme.desc: Billy and the Sillies introduce a visit to chicken A&amp;E, the Squirrels build a bug house, Norrie has her chance to shine, and the Penguins give facts about what's hot and what's not.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - I'm Hungry
programme.desc: King Tiger and the Jelly wonder what Duggee has planned for today. Tag wants a snack, Enid has a musical cheese chase, and Norrie has a haircut.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Seattle Space Needle, USA
programme.desc: The team goes where no Go Jetter has gone before, when Glitch tries to launch into space.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - The Creek
programme.desc: Bored of the local playground, Dad and the kids go out bushwalking on a journey to their local creek. Cast out of her comfort zone, Bluey's eyes are opened to the beauty of the natural world.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Circus
programme.desc: Bluey is the ringmaster in a game of circus with her friends, but Hercules wants to play his motorcycle game instead. Luckily, Bluey has a solution to keep everyone happy.

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions (S1) - Andy and the Baby Dusky Leaf Monkey
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to Malaysia, South East Asia on a baby animal mission to find out why new born dusky leaf monkeys look so different to their parents.

programme.title: Dog Squad (S2) - Mission: Vets
programme.desc: Sylvie the therapy dog has a bit of a sniffle, so they go to see the vet. It's usually Sylvie's job to help others feel calm, but now she needs to help herself stop worrying and also help her owner.

programme.title: Aneeshwar and Lizzie Go Wild (S2) - Golden-Headed Lion Tamarin and Poison Dart Frog
programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie head into the heat of the jungle enclosure to meet a jewel of the jungle, the golden-headed lion tamarin. Next, Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet up with another colourful animal, the poison dart frog. These frogs come in many amazing colours, and they get to meet some blue coloured dart frogs.

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Towel
programme.desc: Bella plays funny games with Lift using her colourful towel. Together, they visit Hettie in the Ice Disco, who uses a big towel to make up a new dance - the Butterfly Boogie!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Perfume Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels make their very own perfumes with accompanying advertisements.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Direction Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels go out for a walk but can't find a way back to the clubhouse.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Board Game Badge
programme.desc: It is a rainy day in the clubhouse which means it's a perfect day for a board game.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Lake Titicaca, South America
programme.desc: What goes up must come down! Grandmaster Glitch lands with a splash in Lake Titicaca in South America.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Leaning Tower of Pisa, Italy
programme.desc: The Go Jetters race to fix the Leaning Tower of Pisa, but has it really been glitched?

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S24) - Nia's Bright Idea
programme.desc: Nia uses what she learns about lighthouses to suggest covering a big wheel in Christmas lights, so that Harold can see where he's going in a storm.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Woolly Memories
programme.desc: Scarf Lady's old film reels get themselves in a tangle, so Sarah and Duck decide to recreate the footage.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Bubble Bumbling
programme.desc: The Bubble Man is in town so a visit to the Big Shop is in order for Sarah, Duck and Donkey.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Circus
programme.desc: The circus bus has broken down, but the children are waiting for a circus show! Can Stanley help out?

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Stuck
programme.desc: Stanley has to free Myrtle, who is stuck, using his new tunnelling mole machine so she can attend the schools tree planting day.

programme.title: Kazoops! (S1) - Animal Pals
programme.desc: Jimmy Jones grows jealous when Monty brings home the class guinea pig for the weekend, leading them to wonder if being best friends means that you can't have other friends too.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S2) - It's Time to go Swimming
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran go swimming in a lido on a hot summer day. JoJo is excited to show Gran Gran what she has learnt in her recent swimming lessons.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Whale Watching
programme.desc: Bluey promises her customer, Bingo, the best tour ever in a game of Whale Watching, but they need Mum and Dad to join in, and they are too tired to play after a late night.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Family Meeting
programme.desc: When Dad's accused of fluffing in Bluey's face as he climbed out of bed, he's put on trial with Mum as the judge, and Bluey and Bingo as witnesses. Bluey might also have to explain what she was doing there.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Faceytalk
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo love to video chat with Muffin and Socks so they can all draw pictures together. When Muffin won't give Socks a turn, the kids discover what happens when you hog.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Days of the Week Badge
programme.desc: After finding out that Mr Wobbly is visiting next Monday, the Squirrels impatiently want to know how long that means they need to wait.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Same Badge
programme.desc: As Peggee and the Hummingbirds journey up the river to deliver a parcel, they have fun spotting and avoiding the wildlife that they meet along the way.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Stick Time
programme.desc: How many siblings does Norrie have? What's Duggee's favourite badge? What does everyone do on Fridays? Squirrel Club has the answers!

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Maasai Mara National Park, Kenya
programme.desc: The team roars into action as Glitch tries to take a selfie with a lion in the Maasai Mara.

programme.desc: Watermelon performs a body tap routine.

programme.desc: Little artichoke sings about being the rhyming queen.

programme.desc: All of the Teletubbies are stuck. Tinky Winky's hand is stuck in the bag, Dipsy's hat is stuck, Laa-Laa's ball is stuck and Po is stuck on the Tubby Slidey!

programme.title: Illicit Desire
programme.desc: This instant cult classic adapts three erotic and mystical tales from the Chinese classical works, with stories spanning across time from the Tang to Ming dynasties. The stories, filled with characters such as emperors, concubines, monks and fortune-tellers, intertwine in a world of adultery, lust and greed, alongside great costumes!

programme.title: Crazy Nuts Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: A roadside bandit and a traveling gambler team up to make money from gambling. In a successful attempt to steal a huge amount of money from a warlord's home, they encounter revolutionists who seek their help to fund the reform campaign. Will the two help the revolutionists' cause with the stolen money?

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couple's brothel.

programme.title: The Story of Sue San
programme.desc: TIn this Huangmei Opera romance, Wang is the son of a respected government official whereas Sue San is a famous prostitute. Although they love each other and seem to be perfectly matched, the two are worlds apart when it comes to social ranking, which will prove hard to overcome...

programme.title: The Jade Raksha
programme.desc: A fearsome swordswoman known as The Jade Raksha appears in the martial arts world and begins killing people whose surname is Yan. A swordsman figures out who she is and asks her why. Apparently a Yan killed her family 18 years ago and she only has vengeance on her mind...

programme.title: Crocodile River
programme.desc: This story has a Romeo and Juliet flavour. Two families who hate each other live across the opposite sides of a river filled with crocodiles and do not bother to have a bridge built. Their respective children meet in university and fall in love, but have to find ways to be together and resolve the hatred between their families.

programme.title: Ode to Gallantry
programme.desc: In this surprisingly light-hearted "Venoms" martial arts adventure, a lone wanderer is repeatedly mistaken for someone else and drawn into a number of violent battles.

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: Hong Kong rhapsody is a musical extravaganza full of song and dance! Peter Chen-Ho stars as a playboy magician who changes his ways after he becomes the guardian of a young singer (Li Ching), the daughter of a deceased magician friend.

programme.title: A Deadly Secret
programme.desc: A corrupt magistrate, obsessed with finding a hidden treasure, jails and tortures his daughter's lover and buries his daughter alive! Ironically, it is in her coffin that the secret to the hidden treasure is found, setting off a frenzy of destruction.

programme.title: Apartment for Ladies
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer comes to Hong Kong in search for her missing younger sister, who had arrived in Hong Kong to be discovered as a nightclub singer. She finds lodging at an apartment for women run by a man-hating landlady, Mrs Chan. However, Mrs Chan cannot confine the young ladies' youthful vitality within the apartment.

programme.title: Opium And The Kung-Fu Master
programme.desc: Tie Qiao San, head of the Ten Guangdong Tigers, is an honourable master with many disciples. As opium becomes popular among the nobles, Tie starts taking it and gradually harms his body. When an opium house's owner defeats Tie in a fight and he is only saved from being killed by his disciple, Tie vows to quit opium and get back on his feet.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Kuo, a police's son, blames his father for his mother's death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

programme.title: The Golden Seal
programme.desc: Dai Tian Chou practices martial arts since young so he can avenge his father's death. He meets Wu Xiao Yan who is disguised as a man one day and is suddenly beaten by a group of gangsters. Wu begs her father to allow her to take Dai back home to recover. Little does Dai know this is his chance to take revenge.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the group's drummerleader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummer's mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the group's drummerleader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummer's mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: Five Superfighters
programme.desc: A kung fu master and his three students lost everything after they are floored by a bully. To take revenge, the students find ways to learn from other kung fu masters and come back six months later to have a rematch with the bully on their master's birthday.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: Woman of the Night
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: Rivals of Kung Fu
programme.desc: As Shen and Wong Fei Hung's relationship turns sour, Shen frames Wong and his disciple for murder. They are saved by a businessman Zhou, but Wong must win the Lion Dance Trophy to return Zhou's favour. Can Wong Fei Hung defeat all skilled martial artists and complete his mission?

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keeper's daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: The Treasure Hunters
programme.desc: Fans of the international star Alexander Fu Sheng were aghast. Their idol had broken both his legs and was recuperating. Everyone wondered: would he be able to return to the action comedies for which he was so famous? This movie was the answer, and it left no doubt that he had made a full recovery. Liu Chia-yung, brother of preeminent martial arts moviemaker Liu Chia-liang, was famous in his own right for kung-fu comedies, and he out-did himself with this one.

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: The Mad Monk is up against the equally legendary scholar-turned-genie, Lu Tung Pin. The duo create havoc as they vie with each other, be it in mirth, magic, women or weapons!

programme.title: The Kid With A Tattoo
programme.desc: Young Bao Tong witnesses the brutal murder of his kung fu master by a vicious villain. A large eagle tattoo on Bao's chest was spotted by the killer as he escapes. Can Bao escape from the killer?

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: Usurpers Of Emperor's Power
programme.desc: The last ruler of Tang, Li Yao is deposed by Chao Kuang-jun, the founder of the Sung Dynasty. Unfortunately his actions unleash a new plague - his brother Kuang-yi - on the courts and his people. The marauding Kuang-yi rapes and plunders. As more people get involved, it turns into a bloody battlefield of betrayal. It is up to upright officials like Li Lang to put an end to it. But can one man take on the imperial army?

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls' high school, is stuck with a baby that isn't his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: The Bully
programme.desc: For lovers of the Shaw's sumptuous production and martial arts expertise, this action adventure in the "Jackie Chan style" is a special treat. A persecuted waiter turns to a "drunken master" for help when a restaurant customer turns out to be a kung-fu harbinger of doom!

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s "a-go-go" era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s "a-go-go" era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Na Cha And The Seven Devils
programme.desc: While stealing one magical peach from a mystic tree in Heaven, Little Na Cha accidentally drops seven others on Earth, which transformed seven different animals into seven devils. Na Cha must hunt the devils down in ten days or his father will be punished by the King of Heaven. Can Na Cha complete his mission?

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: Martial Club
programme.desc: The young Wong Fei Hung and his friend Wang Yin Lin offend the young master of another rival school and the expert they hire, causing both martial arts schools to fight against each other. This is Director Liu Chia Liang's masterpiece and one of the top ten highest grossing movies in 1981.

programme.title: The Dragon Creek
programme.desc: This wuxia murder mystery film talks about a young girl whose father was ruthlessly murdered during China's early republican era. She has a list of villains who have been plotting against her father and together with her elder brother, the young girl sets out on a journey to hunt down the secret serial killer.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman's honour but accidentally kills the governor's son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river's edge, he is rescued by the fisherman's daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: That Man In Chang-an
programme.desc: The Han Emperor dies and his Empress Lu seizes the ruling power. She plots to kill the heir to the throne, Liu Heng, but the masked warrior discovers her plot and tips off Liu. Liu sends his princess to Chang An to ask for help. The masked warrior protects the princess from attackers along the way and supports Liu to become the new Emperor.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: Journey of the Doomed
programme.desc: Journey Of The Doomed stars Tung Wei as a knight that finds himself protecting the life of a beautiful young lady, the lost Emperor's daughter and stalked by a bunch of assassins headed by kung fu actress extraordinaire Hui Ying-Hung.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense...

programme.title: Little Dragon Maiden
programme.desc: Yang Guo and Xiao Long Nu are deeply in love and live harmoniously in the ancient tomb. Xiao Long Nu proposes marriage one day but Yang Guo declines. Heartbroken, she leaves without a word. Devastated by her absence, Yang Guo searches tirelessly for her. When they finally reunite, he begs her to marry him-only for her to refuse his proposal.

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend "Investiture of the Gods", this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

programme.title: The Lady is the Boss
programme.desc: Wong Hsia Yuan is a traditional kung fu master whose academy is on the brink of closure. Chan Mei Ling arrives from U.S. to revitalize the academy but her way of recruiting students is going beyond questionably legal. Yuan is furious, but when the local triads enter the picture, Yuan and Ling join hands to take back the neighborhood.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as "City Lights", is the directorwriter's warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: What Price Honesty
programme.desc: In this period martial arts thriller, three police graduates are assigned to a town rife with crimes and corruption. They vow to uphold justice but are hampered by their corrupt superior, resulting in them putting their lives and the lives of their beloved in danger.

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 3
programme.desc: Gambling tycoon Man suddenly marries his new partner Sophie, which shocked his only son, Ken. In the wake of Man's heart attack, Ken must battle Sophie - who has persuaded Man to transfer his grand master title to her in the event of his death - for the rightful claim to the family's gambling business in a riveting game of mahjong.

programme.title: The Myth
programme.desc: An archaeologist Jack, and a scientist William, stumble upon ancient Qin Dynasty artifacts that lead them to the mausoleum and mysteriously connects Jack to his past life as a warrior in ancient China, starting their mythical journey.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: The Story of Woo Viet
programme.desc: Former Vietnamese veteran Woo Viet arrives a refugee camp in Hong Kong and meets his pen pal Quan. Subsequently, he encounters Shum Ching, with whom he attempts to flee to the US. However, the pair end up stranded in Manila's Chinatown, where at the hands of the local triads Woo becomes a hired killer, while Shum is forced into prostitution.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau's Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city's casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: The Chinese Feast
programme.desc: Sun wants to start a new life as a chef in Canada and struggles to learn cooking skills from a restaurant owner, Au. While Sun will represent his restaurant to participate in a cooking competition, his skill is not good enough, and he has to seek help from a legendary master chef in order to win the ultimate challenge.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student's family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: A Chinese Tall Story
programme.desc: While finding ways to rescue his disciples, Monk Tripitaka meets the lizard imp Mei Yan, the ugliest woman alive. Despite the conflict between good and evil, he falls for Mei Yan who sacrifices herself to save him many times. The Monk breaks his "no killing" rule to save his disciples, and things get more complicated as Princess Galaxy appears...

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei's possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley's mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: All's Well End's Well Too
programme.desc: Another super comedy directed by Clifton Ko about more farcical couplings, mistaken identities, infidelities, and arranged marriages set in the Sung Dynasty.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Fat Choi Spirit
programme.desc: Andy is a mahjong master who is very popular in the neighbourhood. However, after being cursed by his ex-girlfriend, Andy always experiences bad luck when playing mahjong. Can he finally dodge this streak of bad luck?

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: The Exodus
programme.desc: A low-ranking cop discovers a group of women, including his superior, Madam Fang and his wife, plotting to eliminate the world of men.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair II
programme.desc: After being betrayed by Zhuo, the white-haired witch Lian seeks revenge by slaughtering her way through the eight martial arts clans. However, she is soon attacked by a man whose bride she has abducted. Meanwhile, Zhuo, who is waiting on a hilltop for a flower to bloom for Lian's restoration, hastens to save her upon realizing the danger she is in.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Wo Hu
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Police has placed more than a thousand undercover officers in various triad groups to bring down the largest criminal organization in Hong Kong. Betrayal, deceit and murder bring this group of "brothers" into a collision with the law and with each other!

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Everlasting Regret
programme.desc: Adapted from an award-winning Chinese novel, the story follows the life of a legendary Shanghai beauty Wang Qi Yao from her glamorous to her simpler days. She stays true to her own way of life while surviving the constant betrayal of her men, and bears witness to the waves of change to her city from 1947 to 1981.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: To the Fore
programme.desc: The cycling team's top sprinter Zheng Zi Yuan teams up with two domestiques, Ming and Tian, who assist him to win the race. When Ming and Tian get tired of sacrificing their own chances to win, an accident causes the team to break up but the trio soon team up again for another race. Who will be the first to cross the line this time?

programme.title: Model from Hell
programme.desc: Anna, an exceptional student in a modelling school, becomes the target of envy from fellow models, who all die mysteriously when they want to harm her. It turns out that when Anna is upset, she undergoes a terrifying transformation and can wield lethal psychic power...

programme.title: July Rhapsody
programme.desc: A 40-year-old high school teacher is in midlife crisis. His marriage is on the rocks and he is involved in a taboo romance with a female student who has a crush on him. Meanwhile, his wife is off to care for her dying ex-lover who shares a complicated history with the couple...

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Tristar
programme.desc: Young priest Hong disguises himself to protect Bai, a prostitute, while Detective Liu investigates her ties to a prostitution ring. Hong finds Bai a lawful job and helps her negotiate with the underworld. Meanwhile, Liu's investigation causes misunderstandings - can he crack down on the gang? How will Hong manage his emotions as Bai falls for him?

programme.title: Beauty And The 7 Beasts
programme.desc: Teddy, once a renowned movie star, is facing a career decline. To make a living, he accepts five disciples to shape them into stars. Teddy's career regains momentum after he reunites with his long-lost daughter, but he is also confronted by a rival at the same time. His daughter and disciples decide to help him overcome this difficult situation...

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Man Wanted 3
programme.desc: Street kid Dong idolizes Mongkok triad leader Pu Jun and inadvertently joins his gang. When rival Xi Yang seizes control by illicit means, Pu Jun decides to take him down. At the same time, Pu Jun uncovers Dong as a police undercover and banishes him, but Dong sheds his undercover identity to join Pu Jun to seek revenge against Xi Yang.

programme.title: Inner Senses
programme.desc: Haunted by recurring visions stemming from past traumas, Yan reaches out to psychiatrist Dr Jim to restore her sanity and overcome her troubled past. Yet, as Yan gradually heals, Jim finds himself haunted by the same disturbing images, as his suppressed memories resurface.

programme.title: Don't Open Your Eyes
programme.desc: A cop has the ability to see ghosts, which is something that has been passed down from generation to generation in his family. He must learn how to manage this gift when he is confronted by the ghost of a notorious criminal whom he has shot.

programme.title: God of Gambler's Return
programme.desc: The God of Gamblers, Gao Jin, quits gambling and live a quiet life with his wife. However, a Taiwanese crime boss wants to become the new God of Gamblers and get rid of him, so he kills Gao Jin's pregnant wife to force him to the casino table. Gao Jin is indignant and vows to fight the crime boss to avenge his wife's death.

programme.title: Those Were the Days
programme.desc: Director Wong despises Cantonese movies of the 60s, but accidentally travels back in time to that movie set. He meets Director Chu, who tells him he can return to modern time if someone likes the film he makes. Wong meets four classic movie stars and invites them to star in his new film, but it flops unexpectedly. Can Wong return to the present?

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair
programme.desc: As Wudang disciple Zhuo Yi Hang confronts the Demon Palace, he reunites with Lian Ni Shang, the woman who once saved him, and their love reignites. Lian, a disciple of the Demon Palace, endures torment to be with Zhuo but is shattered when he accidentally injures her. A fierce battle between good and evil unfolds!

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: The core rolling news service of CGTN, with regular updates from Beijing, Washington, Nairobi and London, keep viewers up-to-date with all the world’s top stories as they happen. The World Today delivers breaking news, live events, in-depth reporting, expert analysis and sustained coverage.

programme.title: The Agenda
programme.desc: A weekly talk-show looking beyond the headlines and "accepted wisdom" to find the real story. Hosted by award-winning journalist and presenter Stephen Cole, the Agenda quite simply sets the agenda. You won’t find the same-old talking heads recycling platitudes; instead thought-provoking guests to debate and explore key issues of today’s world.

programme.title: Africa Live
programme.desc: Africa Live is a news program that focuses on African issues and issues related to this diverse continent. CGTN’s Nairobi-based broadcast center produces Africa Live. Local correspondents and local production teams provide authoritative and in-depth stories from across the region. Africa Live is an objective and comprehensive look at every facet of African life.

programme.title: Talk Africa
programme.desc: Talk Africa is a weekly discussion show that brings the most influential voices in Africa to the world. Broadcast from CGTN’s production center in the Kenyan capital, Nairobi, Talk Africa looks at Africa and the world from an African perspective.

programme.title: Sports Scene
programme.desc: Sports Scene brings you closer to all the action from all corners of the world, with highlights from across Europe, North America and China's top sports leagues. We examine the changes and growth in China's domestic leagues, as the country undergoes an incredible economic transformation.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - How Can We Find Sammy Snail?

programme.desc: Jess is very worried about Hedgehog. He keeps curling up into a ball and Jess thinks he must need help and wants to find out how he can make his little friend feel better. Jess thinks he may need help building a little house, or that he's cold or needs a drink. But it's only when his farmyard buddies who are busy playing 'Scarey Steps' come and shout 'Scarey!' that Jess realises little HH curles up when he's frightened.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - How Can We Make The Most Beautiful Garden Ever?
programme.desc: Poor Mimi! Her normally beautiful garden is all messy and full of swirly piles of earth. She's really upset and Jess promises to her help her make it the most beautiful garden ever! Raking away the swirls doesn't work, they just come back! Jess and Mimi realise that worms are making the swirly piles of earth. Mimi wants to move them away but they go back underground before she can catch them.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - Why Are There Little Hills In The Orchard?
programme.desc: Jess and the pups have been looking after the orchard while Willow's been on holiday but the day she's due back the orchard is full of little piles of earth. What's making them? That's the Big Question. Jess wonders if someone put them there. He asks Mimi, who's making a pile of earth while she digs a hole. She tells him she's going to plant an apple tree. Maybe someone's been planting new apple trees in the orchard thinks Jess.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - Why Are There So Many Ladybirds?

Sheriff Gabby and Sheriff Pandy must safely deliver gold to the bank, but it gets confiscated by Bandit CatRat! They go on an adventure to get the gold back and restore order in the dollhouse.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - DJ Catnip Gets His Groove Back
programme.desc: Gabby brings DJ Catnip a microphone for him to use in the big music show, but he has some terrible news: he lost his groove! Determined to help him get his groove back, Gabby and Pandy take him on a musical search through the dollhouse. As they go, Gabby uses the microphone to record sounds from the Gabby Cats’ everyday activities that culminate into a new song that gets DJ his groove back just in time for the show! In our Gabby Cat of the Day Segment, Gabby sings a song!

programme.title: Shades of Life - EP4
programme.desc: Ko Ba-dou (Yu Yang), a retired school principal with a deep love for traditional Chinese culture, values ​​family ethics and is highly respected by his family. His eldest son, Ko Ho-pan (Wu Nuoyan), a journalism graduate and magazine editor, is a prodigy who seeks to get to the bottom of things. On livelihood issues, he occasionally disagrees with his father, holding different views.

programme.title: Knot To Treasure - EP17
programme.desc: Wei (Zhu Jiang), the eldest son of Wei (Chen Jiewen), is wild and untamed. Under family pressure, he finally marries Shan (Zhang Fengni), with whom he has been dating for many years. After their marriage, Yat-sen develops an extramarital affair with Yan (Cui Jiabao), eventually living with her and abandoning Shan. Later, realizing Yan's overly open attitude towards relationships, he decides to pursue Shan again.

programme.title: Bottled Passion - EP11
programme.desc: MRS. KO TUNG KWOK-HING (Chan Sau Chu) lies to her husband KO SHIU-TONG (Kwok Fung) that the orphan boy she brings home is his long lost illegal son, KO YEE-HO. TONG believes HO will make a better heir than his elder son, KO YEE-TAI (Chan Shan Chung), resulting in HING’s kicking HO out of the house in anger. HO has been living a vagabond life since. After having enough of the bitter taste of life, he is determined to let the KO family know how it feels to lose one’s family.

programme.title: Bottled Passion - EP21
programme.desc: MRS. KO TUNG KWOK-HING (Chan Sau Chu) lies to her husband KO SHIU-TONG (Kwok Fung) that the orphan boy she brings home is his long lost illegal son, KO YEE-HO. programme.title: The Price Of Greed - EP3
programme.desc: Police Constable LUI TO (WONG CHUNG CHAK, BOSCO) is shocked to discover that TSU FUNG (CHAN KIN FUNG, SAMMUL), who has reportedly gone missing for a year, is already dead and that his body has been claimed by his girlfriend LAM PING (TSUI KATE TSZ SHAN). Then, suddenly and mysteriously, FUNG, who is believed to be dead, turns up again, which makes the enigma even more intriguing. The relationship between PING and FUNG is also put to the test amidst such confusion.

TONG believes HO will make a better heir than his elder son, KO YEE-TAI (Chan Shan Chung), resulting in HING’s kicking HO out of the house in anger. HO has been living a vagabond life since. After having enough of the bitter taste of life, he is determined to let the KO family know how it feels to lose one’s family.

programme.title: The Price Of Greed - EP3
programme.desc: Police Constable LUI TO (WONG CHUNG CHAK, BOSCO) is shocked to discover that TSU FUNG (CHAN KIN FUNG, SAMMUL), who has reportedly gone missing for a year, is already dead and that his body has been claimed by his girlfriend LAM PING (TSUI KATE TSZ SHAN). Then, suddenly and mysteriously, FUNG, who is believed to be dead, turns up again, which makes the enigma even more intriguing. The relationship between PING and FUNG is also put to the test amidst such confusion.

programme.title: Shades of Life - EP5
programme.desc: Ko Ba-dou (Yu Yang), a retired school principal with a deep love for traditional Chinese culture, values ​​family ethics and is highly respected by his family. His eldest son, Ko Ho-pan (Wu Nuoyan), a journalism graduate and magazine editor, is a prodigy who seeks to get to the bottom of things. On livelihood issues, he occasionally disagrees with his father, holding different views.

programme.title: Knot To Treasure - EP18
programme.desc: Wei (Zhu Jiang), the eldest son of Wei (Chen Jiewen), is wild and untamed. Under family pressure, he finally marries Shan (Zhang Fengni), with whom he has been dating for many years. After their marriage, Yat-sen develops an extramarital affair with Yan (Cui Jiabao), eventually living with her and abandoning Shan. Later, realizing Yan's overly open attitude towards relationships, he decides to pursue Shan again.

programme.title: Happy Ever After - EP6
programme.desc: TUNG KOON (AU YEUNG CHUN WAH, BOBBY) born with a special ‘King’s Tongue’ is betrayed by his assistant, SIU SIU (CHAN MIU YING, MARIANE) who had prepared some chili source without permission. TUNG is accused of deceiving the Emperor and is forced to flee from Guangzhou to the capital. When SIU discovered that someone had used her to trap TUNG, she sees TUNG in person and apologizes. TUNG and SIU eventually reconcile. Love feeling blossoms between them.

programme.title: L'Escargot - EP15
programme.desc: Renovation contractor KWAN KA-ON (Miu Kiu Wai) is the elder of four siblings, while his wife SZE LONG-KIU (Sonija Kwok) is a typical housewife. Buying a house is their longtime dream. But when his eldest brother, KWAN KA-HONG’s business goes under, they shelve their plan to help him overcome his difficulties. KIU has to look for a job too.

programme.title: A Perfect Man - EP6
programme.desc: Yeung Yat-cheng (Joe Ma) has a good reputation in the realm of personal security. He is invited by his buddy Ha Chung-chau (Tsui Wing) to join a security company that is tasked with protecting a tycoon called Tseung Ding-tin (KK Cheung). While starting his new job, Yat-cheung is faced with personnel issues. Meanwhile, due to his unhappy childhood, Yat-cheng does not believe in marriage. However, he happens to hook up with Yau Chi-ching (Ali Lee).

programme.title: A STEP INTO THE PAST - EP12
programme.desc: HONG SHIU LUNG (KOO TIN LOK, LOUIS) is an secret agent in the 21st Century. He joins a pilot programme to fly back in time hoping that he will salvage his unforgettable love. However, something goes wrong during the mission. He is sent back to the Warring States Period. Emperor QI (LAM RAYMOND) has not been crowned yet and is kept hostage in Chiu. In order to return to the future, LUNG decides to help QI become emperor. With his wisdom and Kungfu, he is recognized and given important tasks.

programme.title: The Exorcist's 2nd Meter - EP19
programme.desc: Taxi driver Ma Kwai (Kenneth Ma) goes down the road to exorcism as he is destined to perpetuate the legacy of genie Shek Kam-dong. He is also reunited with the mature soul of his buddy Mok Wai-ho (Hubert Wu). He even encounters Sze Loi-sze (Gloria Tang) and his younger brother Sze Lo-sze, who are both exorcists. However, some demonic curse has caused Ma Kwai to keep thinking of a doctor by the name of Chong Tsz-yeuk (Mandy Wong).

He is invited by his buddy Ha Chung-chau (Tsui Wing) to join a security company that is tasked with protecting a tycoon called Tseung Ding-tin (KK Cheung). While starting his new job, Yat-cheung is faced with personnel issues. Meanwhile, due to his unhappy childhood, Yat-cheng does not believe in marriage. However, he happens to hook up with Yau Chi-ching (Ali Lee).

programme.title: A STEP INTO THE PAST - EP13
programme.desc: HONG SHIU LUNG (KOO TIN LOK, LOUIS) is an secret agent in the 21st Century. He joins a pilot programme to fly back in time hoping that he will salvage his unforgettable love. However, something goes wrong during the mission. He is sent back to the Warring States Period. Emperor QI (LAM RAYMOND) has not been crowned yet and is kept hostage in Chiu. In order to return to the future, LUNG decides to help QI become emperor. With his wisdom and Kungfu, he is recognized and given important tasks.

programme.title: The Exorcist's 2nd Meter - EP21
programme.desc: Taxi driver Ma Kwai (Kenneth Ma) goes down the road to exorcism as he is destined to perpetuate the legacy of genie Shek Kam-dong. He is also reunited with the mature soul of his buddy Mok Wai-ho (Hubert Wu). He even encounters Sze Loi-sze (Gloria Tang) and his younger brother Sze Lo-sze, who are both exorcists. However, some demonic curse has caused Ma Kwai to keep thinking of a doctor by the name of Chong Tsz-yeuk (Mandy Wong).

programme.title: Happy Ever After - EP7
programme.desc: TUNG KOON (AU YEUNG CHUN WAH, BOBBY) born with a special ‘King’s Tongue’ is betrayed by his assistant, SIU SIU (CHAN MIU YING, MARIANE) who had prepared some chili source without permission. TUNG is accused of deceiving the Emperor and is forced to flee from Guangzhou to the capital. When SIU discovered that someone had used her to trap TUNG, she sees TUNG in person and apologizes. TUNG and SIU eventually reconcile. Love feeling blossoms between them.

programme.title: 直播｜封關“滿月”！日均購物總額1.6億 海南消費爲何這麼熱？
programme.desc: 2026年1月18日，海南自由貿易港封關運作正式迎來“滿月”。一個月，在宏觀經濟的時間軸上或許並不算長，卻足以讓消費市場的新變化清晰顯現。這一個月，海南自貿港的哪些商品品類最受關注？消費者在購物中感受到了怎樣的變與不變？封關後的海南消費市場又將如何煥發新的活力？本期節目，我們通過“演播室深度解讀+前方實地探訪”的多場景模式，連線海口和萬寧兩地，並邀請相關專家，全方位剖析海南封關後的消費新生態。

programme.title: 2026冬季達沃斯｜國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）總裁、歐洲央行行長等分享全球經濟展望
programme.desc: 預計2026年全球經濟將增長約3.1%，但貿易緊張局勢、技術應用、公共債務以及資產泡沫風險令政策制定者和市場保持高度警惕。哪些政策能夠鞏固信心，同時釋放長期生產力增長潛力？

programme.title: 2026冬季達沃斯｜月之暗面總裁等探討中國的AI+經濟
programme.desc: 87%的中國企業計劃在2025年增加人工智能投資，超過半數的企業表示進展速度超出預期，這表明中國人工智能發展勢頭正在加速。與此同時，國務院發佈的“人工智能+行動計劃”正在推動人工智能在製造業、能源、醫療保健、金融和零售等重點領域的應用，但許多企業仍然難以將前景廣闊的試點項目轉化爲可衡量的實際成果。\r\n會議將探討中國不斷發展的人工智能架構如何彌合這一差距，以及其“人工智能+”方法能爲全球人工智能戰略提供哪些經驗借鑑。

programme.title: 2026冬季達沃斯｜朱民、許冉等探討中國經濟：全面崛起
programme.desc: 四十多年來，中國構建了一種融合計劃、創新和全球化的混合增長模式。這種模式推動了製造業、清潔能源以及近年來人工智能領域的顯著發展。隨着壓力和風險的增加，這種獨特的增長模式的下一個階段將如何發展？

programme.desc: 2025年的最後一天，第一財經陪你一起度過。即將過去的2025年，生活彷彿被按下了加速鍵，信息爆炸，似乎所有行業都在發生着鉅變。關稅、股市、黃金價格都成爲每日上下翻飛、隨時要衝破記錄的數字，攪動着國際貿易與大國關係，也攪動着我們每個人的日常生活。大模型、機器人、商業航天，硬科技的迅猛發展帶飛了全球資本的流向，令人應接不暇的同時也讓我們思考如何能跟上這樣的節奏。而當新能源車、外賣等行業的競爭進入白熱化、幾十億的資金一天內就能燒完時候，我們一邊更加謹慎的用訂單投票，一邊開始反思如此“內卷”何時有盡頭。所以現在，讓我們一起把時間往回撥，細數2025年，在世界極速變動的當下，我們如何在宏大的敘事中探知未來的模樣，如何在微小的快樂中感受生活的溫度。\r\n我們選取了十個關鍵詞，邀請多位業內重磅嘉賓，一起聊一聊關於2025年的記憶，一起來讀懂經濟裏的人間煙火。

programme.desc: 12月12日，爲期3天的2025全球開發者先鋒大會暨國際具身智能技能大賽在上海張江正式啓幕！這裏的機器人不光能在廢墟中逆行救援、車間裏微米級裝配，還會疊帶污漬的衣服、插錯落有致的鮮花，把“實驗室黑科技”活成了觸手可及的“人間煙火氣”。這場全球頂尖技能比拼，既是技術實力的擂臺，更是資本嗅覺的風向標 —— 既折射出 “十五五”規劃建議中“推動具身智能成爲新經濟增長點” 的政策東風，更藏着2035年突破萬億元的市場藍海。當機器人走進廚房、工廠、醫院，這條 “技術 + 資本” 雙驅動的賽道，到底有哪些普通人也能關注的投資機會？12月12日14:00《數新風》，帶您直擊張江賽場一線：看機器人 “會幹活” 的硬核實力，拆萬億賽道 “能賺錢” 的佈局密碼，一起解鎖科技與生活碰撞的財富新風向！
